text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks) had 
arrived. As for Nishino Flower's weight—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It went back to normal! Peace... ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, we couldn't do the ideal training 
you originally planned out for me, 
Trainer...

True, she might not be in the exact 
condition we had originally envisioned. 
But we've done everything we can. All 
that's left is...
choice_data_list:
Let's give it our all and finish the race 
with no regrets!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. I'll go out there and do my 
absolute best...!"

"To be honest, it's an unknown quantity 
how well she can perform in 
medium-distance races."

Because she skipped grades to debut, she's 
younger than the other girls. That means 
she's still handicapped by having a 
smaller build.

Watching her run medium distances feels 
different from when she was praised by 
Sakura Bakushin O and Yamanin Zephyr 
before the Oka Sho. However...

Anything can happen in a race. For now, 
let's just believe in everything built up 
so far... and watch over her with faith.
